text.en:
The amount of one thousand pesos appro-priated under paragraph A-(c) ; Samar, item numbered
thirty-seven of section one of Act Numbered Forty-one hundred and eighty of the Philippine Legislature is
reap-propriated for the construction of the Biri Elementary School, Calbiga, Samar.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1938.
